clips.title: The story
paras: On the snowy road from Coldridge Pass to Kharanos, Hegnar Rumbleshot keeps a gunsmith's camp. He supplies local hunters and mountaineers with firearms and ammunition.

Hegnar Rumbleshot keeps a small camp between Coldridge Pass and Kharanos, where he serves dwarven marksmen, travelers, and the local militia. At the camp, mountain folk use a popular range to hone their aim against the wild beasts prowling Dun Morogh. The steady stream of shooters leaves Hegnar in need of fresh ammunition from his supplier, the dwarf engineer Loslor Rudge.
